text:
### Geographic Risk  
**High-Risk Countries:**
- OFAC List: Iran, North Korea, Syria, Crimea, Cuba, Sudan
- EU Consolidated List: Various sanctioned entities
- HMT Sanctions: Additional UK-sanctioned entities
- High-corruption countries: Nigeria, Zimbabwe, Venezuela
name: Chunk 9/61

raw_entities.name: OFAC Sanctioned Country Risk
raw_entities.description: Staff must recognise customer or transaction connections to countries on the OFAC sanctions list as a high-risk indicator requiring immediate escalation. The OFAC list includes Iran, North Korea, Syria, Crimea, Cuba, and Sudan.
context: OFAC List: Iran, North Korea, Syria, Crimea, Cuba, Sudan

raw_entities.name: EU Consolidated Sanctions List Entity Risk
raw_entities.description: Staff must identify customers or entities appearing on the EU Consolidated Sanctions List as a compliance red flag requiring verification and potential escalation.
context: EU Consolidated List: Various sanctioned entities

raw_entities.name: HMT UK Sanctions List Entity Risk
raw_entities.description: Staff must screen customers and transactions against the UK Her Majesty's Treasury sanctions list to identify additional UK-sanctioned entities beyond OFAC and EU lists.

raw_entities.name: High-Corruption Country Risk
raw_entities.description: Staff must treat customers with connections to high-corruption countries as elevated risk, requiring enhanced due diligence and source of funds verification. Identified high-corruption countries include Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and Venezuela.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory screening process against multiple sanctions lists including OFAC, EU Consolidated List, and HMT UK sanctions to identify and prevent transactions with sanctioned countries and entities.
context: OFAC List: Iran, North Korea, Syria, Crimea, Cuba, Sudan
